subject: Re: Recovery validation sprint — RTO/RPO evidence index and ops deliverables
messages:
From: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@greenshard.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwoodai.com, monica_patel@redwoodai.com
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@greenshard.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recovery validation — consolidated ask and timeline

Hi Aisha / Monica,

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. As part of our SIG questionnaire closure we need a short, consumable package covering your RTO and RPO assertions for the hosted API (region: us-west-2) and a simple inventory of the evidence items you can provide this quarter. Specifically Greenshard is asking for:

- A single spreadsheet mapping critical services -> RTO/RPO targets -> evidence artifact (snapshot/log/runbook)
- Recent runbook excerpts that show recovery steps for a full service restart (ops steps, warm-cache restore)
- Screenshots or export of last successful failover test and timestamped logs for KV cache warm-up if available
- A single point-of-contact and a proposed 2-week validation sprint schedule

Can you send an inventory (spreadsheet) and a proposed sprint plan by EOD Friday 5/15? ProcureOps will need that to finalize the SIG risk posture update.

Appreciate it — Erin
Erin Shaw
Sr. Security Program Manager, GreenShard
From: aisha_rahman@redwoodai.com
To: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@greenshard.com>, ProcureOps <procure@greenshard.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodai.com, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recovery validation — consolidated ask and timeline

Erin — thanks for the clear list. We're able to meet the ask and will run a focused validation sprint next week to collect the artifacts. High-level plan below; attaching the starter evidence index (RTO-RPO-evidence-index-v1.xlsx).

Plan (2-week sprints, US-west scope):
- Week A (5/17–5/21): Artifact collection and runbook snapshotting (Ben + Diego)
- Week B (5/24–5/28): Execute a targeted failover test in staging; capture warm-cache timings and logs (Monica + Diego)
- Deliverables by 5/28: populated evidence spreadsheet, runbook excerpts, failover test log bundle, warm-cache timing chart

Owners: Ben Carter (artifact assembly), Diego Fernandez (failover test), Monica Patel (ops verification), Aisha Rahman (SOC/SIG coordinator)

We're attaching an initial index with what we already have and gaps noted. Ben — please start the inventory and add file links to the Drive folder Erin referenced. Diego — please confirm test window availability for 5/26.

Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Manager, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwoodai.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwoodai.com, monica_patel@redwoodai.com, diego_fernandez@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recovery validation — consolidated ask and timeline

Adding the initial inventory notes — I pulled artifacts from the ops archive and flagged where we need a fresh extract:

- api-gateway (critical): RTO 15m / RPO 5m -> evidence: deployment rollback steps (runbook v2.1), recent failover log (2026-03-19) -> STATUS: OK
- kv-cache (critical): RTO 5m / RPO 1m -> evidence: warm-cache snapshot process (diagram attached), last warm-cache log missing timestamps -> ACTION: Diego to extract 2026-04-30 warm-cache logs
- model-serving (tier1): RTO 30m / RPO 15m -> evidence: orchestration job history and snapshot -> STATUS: needs re-run in staging

I uploaded the starter matrix to the shared Drive and attached the XLSX for this thread. I'm marking items that need live verification in Week B.

Attachments: RTO-RPO-evidence-index-v1.xlsx

Ben
From: diego_fernandez@redwoodai.com
To: ben_carter@redwoodai.com, aisha_rahman@redwoodai.com, monica_patel@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recovery validation — consolidated ask and timeline

I can take the 5/26 staging window. Plan for the failover test (5/26 02:00–04:00 PT):
- Pre-checks (02:00–02:20): verify precondition snapshots and quiesce low-priority jobs
- Failover trigger (02:20): simulate primary region outage for the service group (API + model-serving + kv-cache)
- Warm-cache restore (02:25–02:50): restore from persistent snapshot, run warm-up profile
- Verification (02:50–03:30): smoke tests and latency probes; collect logs and timing chart
- Rollback and reconciliation (03:30–04:00)

I will capture the KV cache warm-up logs; Ben — I'll drop the raw log file to the Drive link and attach a chart in the final bundle.

Diego
From: aisha_rahman@redwoodai.com
To: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@greenshard.com>, ProcureOps <procure@greenshard.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodai.com, diego_fernandez@redwoodai.com, monica_patel@redwoodai.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recovery validation — consolidated ask and timeline

Erin — initial inventory attached. We scheduled the staging failover for 5/26 per Diego's availability. Deliverables we will provide by 5/28:

- Populated evidence index (RTO-RPO-evidence-index-v1.xlsx) — contains links to artifacts and gap flags
- runbook-stopgap-excerpt.pdf — excerpt of the recovery runbook for API and cache recovery steps (internal reference IDs included)
- warm-cache-topology.png — diagram of cache topology and warm-up flow
- Test log bundle: will be uploaded after 5/26 test (JIRA: SECOPS-4821 will track artifacts)

If Greenshard needs any of the artifacts earlier or wants the raw logs before 5/28, we can provide them as they come out of the test.

Thanks — Aisha
From: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@greenshard.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwoodai.com, ProcureOps <procure@greenshard.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recovery validation — consolidated ask and timeline

Aisha — thanks, this looks like exactly what we need. The evidence package in Drive is sufficient for preliminary SIG review; ProcureOps will confirm final acceptance after reviewing the post-test log bundle. One small ask: can you add the exact timestamp (UTC) of the warm-cache ready state in the final spreadsheet? That will let our risk team map warm-up durations against our ingest windows.

If you can add that by EOD 5/21 we'll be able to close the outstanding SIG question ahead of our 5/27 compliance checkpoint.

Best,
Erin
